programs.title: The Yangtze River Estuary No 2 Shipwreck Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary showcases modern engineering and ancient culture, chronicling the excavation, relocation, preservation, and museum display of an ancient boat. It offers an exclusive look at the Chinese solutions behind several world-first technologies—revealing the dual wisdom of Chinese-style modernization and traditional culture while fostering cross-cultural dialogue and mutual learning.

programs.title: The Lush Green Gannan Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary captures the remarkable transformation of Gannan over the past decade, a region that serves as a critical water source and recharge zone for the upper reaches of the Yellow and Yangtze rivers, a national ecological functional area, and a pilot zone for ecological civilization.
